verdict.rationale: There is a Shopify quickstart integration where 'Forter handles everything' (forter-docs-7, forter-docs-29) and a Stripe dispute-webhook integration guide, plus a Salesforce Commerce reference in extensions/configure-decisions (Merchant Tools > Site Preferences suggests SFCC/commerce cloud extension). However there's no dedicated evidence for BigCommerce or a broader roster of major PSPs beyond Stripe, and no evidence of ongoing maintenance/version history for these integrations. missing for 10: dedicated BigCommerce integration docs, confirmation of Salesforce Commerce Cloud as a named maintained integration, coverage of multiple major PSPs beyond Stripe, and evidence of active maintenance/versioning of these integrations.
